name: DILF Chronicles
source:
DILF Chronicles follows the adventures of the main character, Logan, as he goes about his life as a professor at Cockville College, a small college in a mid-sized city.
The college may be small but the football program is big and the athletes are hot! As are the other students and the guys Logan encounters in his day to day activities.
We’re talking librarians, pizza delivery boys, firemen, baristas, retail clerks, etc. Just some of the guys are shown here, and the possibilities are endless.
So too are the kinds of mischief these young, handsome guys can get up to with Logan and each other.
